result.title: PINNeval: A Comprehensive Evaluation Standard for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
result.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 54 pages. Code: https://github.com/KevinvonBargen/pinnpipe
result.summary: The Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) literature has produced a rapidly expanding catalogue of methods. We divide a PINN training pipeline systematically into four components and observe that many existing benchmarks study these components in isolation. These components are domain-importance adaptation, loss balancing, neural network architecture, and optimization scheme. Moreover, the studies set the surrounding and not considered components of the pipeline to a minimal default that is no longer representative of current best practice approaches. Conclusions drawn under such conditions may not transfer to competitive pipelines. In this work, we propose a new evaluation protocol that (1) treats the four components as an integrated system; (2) crucially requires competitive implementations of the components not under investigation; (3) specifies the metrics and reporting format; and (4) is accompanied by structured documentation that ensures the traceability of evaluations across studies. Based on this comprehensive protocol, we release PINNpipe, an innovative JAX package containing 18 different methods from the current literature as well as nine efficiently implemented benchmark problems. Using PINNpipe, we illustrate our evaluation protocol in relation to established benchmark studies and report results that challenge common assumptions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一套 PINN 综合评测协议，把域重要性自适应、损失平衡、网络架构与优化方案四个组件视为整体系统来考察，要求非研究对象采用当前有竞争力的实现，并发布含 18 种方法与 9 个基准问题的 JAX 包 PINNpipe。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「整体评测＋强基线＋可追溯记录」的协议思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等模块的贡献分配与消融设计，避免以弱默认实现得出错误归因；但领域较远，需人工判断可迁移性。
